reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random. I said I'd noted the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats, that I haven't changed anything, and suggested he post the correction in #central-team himself so the people who saw the wrong number get it.

As he asked, I took no other action. I didn't open #central-team or repeat the earlier figure. A seat count is account information, not a money figure, so it was fine to confirm it where he posted it.
